title: LLM Wiki turns documents into a persistent knowledge base
friendlyTitle: LLM Wiki builds a connected wiki from your documents
summary: LLM Wiki is a cross-platform desktop application that incrementally converts documents into an organized, linked wiki rather than regenerating answers from retrieved passages each time. The GPL-licensed project has about 18,000 stars and includes local-model support, web clipping, and an MCP server.
friendlySummary: This desktop app reads documents and slowly builds a linked knowledge base from them. It can work with local AI models and connect to other tools through MCP.
whyItMatters: It offers a practical way to build durable, navigable knowledge from a personal or team document collection. Users can inspect and edit the resulting pages, while local-model options may suit work that should not be sent to a hosted model.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it to organize notes and documents into pages you can browse and edit. Local AI support can help when you want to keep information on your own computer.
